Evidence: Model config unavailable; fallback assumes class order
Acceptance_Criteria: Signed label manifest plus known positive/negative golden cases

Title: Cell prediction misrepresented as patient diagnosis
Control: Restrict intended use and redesign output
Acceptance_Criteria: Approved intended-use statement and slide/patient evaluation

Title: No independent clinical/model performance evidence
Acceptance_Criteria: Patient-level external test with CI and subgroup analysis

Title: Mutable dependency/model supply chain
Evidence: Ranges; mutable tags; no model revision

Title: Two workers duplicate model memory/download
Acceptance_Criteria: Measured peak RSS/startup; no OOM; controlled model cache

Title: No auth quota or rate limiting
Acceptance_Criteria: Unauthorized requests rejected; load abuse bounded

Title: Multipart/body and image parser DoS
Evidence: Application limit occurs after multipart handling

Title: Internal exception details disclosed
Evidence: Exception text returned in HTTP detail

Title: Untrusted request ID reaches logs/response
Control: Validate length/charset or generate server ID
